# e2e_image (Resource)

Provides an e2e image resource.
This resource allows you to manage images on your e2e clusters. When applied, a new image is created. When destroyed, this node is removed.

~> **Migration Notice**: This resource has parameter changes in v3.0.0. See the [v3.0.0 Upgrade Guide](../guides/upgrade-to-v3.md#affected-resources) for migration instructions.

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->

## Example Usage

```hcl
 resource "e2e_image" "image1" {
	name     =   "demo_image"
    node_id  =   e2e_node.node1.id
    project_id = <project_id:string>
    region   = <region:string>  # Use 'region' instead of deprecated 'location' (must be same as corresponding node region)
 }
```

## Schema

### Argument Reference

- `node_id` : (Required)(String) Id of the node you want to create image of. To find the node id, please refer to our [`API Documentation`](https://docs.e2enetworks.com/api/myaccount/#/paths/nodes/get)
- `name` : (Required)(String) The name of the image.
- `project_id` : (Required)(String) project id associated to the node. To find the project id, please refer to our [`API Documentation`](https://docs.e2enetworks.com/api/myaccount/#/paths/pbac-projects-header/get)
- `region` : (Required)(String) region of the image (Must be same as corresponding node region)
- `location` : (Optional, **Deprecated**) Use `region` instead. Will be removed in v3.0.0.

### Attribute Reference (read only)

- `template_id` (String) Template id of the image. Used when you want to create node using this image.
- `image_state` (String) Current state of the image.
- `os_distribution` (String) OS distribution
- `image_type` (String) Type of the image
- `distro` (String) Distro type
- `created_at` (String, Computed) Creation time of the image (timestamp)
- `creation_time` (String, Computed, **Deprecated**) Use `created_at` instead. Will be removed in v3.0.0.
